name: Benji
slug: Benji is familiar with The Reach and may be at the party's bar.
description: Benji has frequented The Reach many times.

log.summary: The party considers asking Benji for information because of his familiarity with The Reach. They are uncertain where he currently is and recall that he may have been left at their bar.
notes: The party considers asking Benji for information because he has frequented The Reach many times.

log.summary: Benji is credited with helping the Haven Hold dragon enchant its hoard as the penultimate Sunder Chase prize, tying his prior familiarity with The Reach to the event's magical setup at Haven Hold.
notes: Worked with the Haven Hold dragon to enchant its hoard as the penultimate Sunder Chase prize.

log.summary: Sylan thinks Benji may have a lead once the party is home, and wants to question him about what they are hunting if he is in town. The party does not confirm that he is there.
notes: Sylan thinks Benji may have a lead once the party is home and wants to question him about what they are hunting if he is in town. The party does not confirm that he is there.

log.summary: Benji was asleep in a pile of old memorabilia at the base of the lighthouse, near part of a burlap sack, until the fight woke him. He props himself on a crate and watches the briefing. He smokes a copper corncob pipe packed with a grass-like material, not tobacco, primed with a drop from a small oil dripper. The smoke is dark like a coal boiler and smells half of sulfur and half earthy. He keeps relighting it; it sputters, sparks, and leaves an acrid smell. Carlkin includes him when paper is needed and sets him a cup with the party. When Carlkin freezes at the Book of Vecna, Benji says there is a lot to take in and asks whether the dragon rider was from The Reach.
